      "question": "是否识别出 Z33 作为主要诊断时的规则效果及其业务含义？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须明确：Z33（附带妊娠状态）仅可作附加说明，不能作为入组主要诊断；把它放在主要诊断位置会触发编码排除/阻断，不能按原主诊直接入组。允许等义表述，不要求逐字复述规则编号。"
    },
    {
      "id": "z33_disposition",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "是否给出了与规则矩阵一致的后续处置？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须明确：调整主要诊断排序（回归本次住院实际治疗疾病，采用合适的真实疾病作为主诊）并重新预分组/重跑分组；不能仅保留 Z33 原主诊后直接放行。"
    },
    {
      "id": "released_case_evidence",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "是否从质控清单准确识别出已更正、复核并放行的 Z33 异常病案及其原建议值和调整建议？",
      "pass_anchor": "必须同时给出：病案号 250210455；原建议代码 Z33.x00（原主要诊断为附带妊娠状态）；调整后的建议诊断为妊娠期高血压，建议代码 O13.x00；该记录结算放行状态为已放行。若回答主动声称 Z33 闭环病案总数或列举其他 Z33 病案，所述数量和记录必须与清单一致（已更正、复核并放行共 2 例），不得写成 11 例等错误事实。"
    },
    {
      "id": "z33_claim_consistency",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_z33_claim_consistency",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "若回答扩展声称 Z33 病案数量或列举其他 Z33 病案，是否与质控清单事实一致？",
      "pass_anchor": "不作扩展声称则通过；若声称数量或列举记录，必须与清单中 Z33 异常且已闭环放行的 2 例一致。",
      "weight": 0
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "\"\"\"Check optional Z33 case-count/list claims against the source workbook.\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nfrom openpyxl import load_workbook\n\ndef check_z33_claim_consistency(workspace):\n    answer = (workspace / \"answer.md\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\") if (workspace / \"answer.md\").exists() else \"\"\n    source = workspace / \"02_预分组分析/澄湖人民医院2025年2月病案首页分组质控清单.xlsx\"\n    if not source.exists():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"质控清单缺失\"}\n    ws = load_workbook(source, data_only=True, read_only=True)[\"异常病案清单\"]\n    closed = set()\n    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=7, values_only=True):\n        case, desc, orig, conclusion, completion, release = row[2], row[8], row[10], row[22], row[25], row[26]\n        if ((str(orig or \"\").startswith(\"Z33\") or \"Z33\" in str(desc or \"\"))\n                and completion and conclusion in {\"同意修改\", \"维持原值\", \"补充证据后通过\"}\n                and release == \"已放行\"):\n            closed.add(str(case))\n    if closed != {\"250210455\", \"250210972\"}:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"源清单闭环集合异常\"}\n    # Only police claims explicitly tied to the Z33 case evidence, leaving omission acceptable.\n    for line in answer.splitlines():\n        if \"Z33\" not in line:\n            continue\n        counts = []\n        counts += re.findall(r\"(?<!\\d)(\\d+)\\s*例[^，。；;]{0,20}(?:Z33|妊娠状态)\", line)\n        counts += re.findall(r\"(?:Z33|妊娠状态)[^，。；;]{0,20}?(\\d+)\\s*例\", line)\n        if counts and any(int(n) != len(closed) for n in counts):\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Z33 数量声称与清单不符\"}\n        ids = re.findall(r\"(?:250210\\d{3}|CY2502-\\d{4})\", line)\n        if ids and any(case not in closed for case in ids):\n            return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"Z33 病案号声称与清单不符\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Z33 扩展声称与清单一致或未声称\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "workspace",
  "act": "none",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
